reconcileDrift: The production data-manager handoff found that current confirmation opens only after ScreenStore emits Completed, so destructive commands would mutate before confirmation and confirm() only dismisses. AppSpec requires pre-mutation confirmation for deletes, replacement restore, reset and destructive discard paths.
goal: Introduce a typed, serializable pre-mutation confirmation contract: destructive Execute requests confirmation without touching the Store/manager; confirm dispatches a distinct confirmed action exactly once to the active component; cancel/back/dismiss mutate nothing; state restoration preserves the pending command safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Every destructive operation named by the assigned ACs is classified centrally and cannot reach ScreenStore/ScreenDataManager before explicit confirmation.
The pending typed command is retained in serializable Decompose slot configuration without relying on string-prefix heuristics.
Confirm dismisses the slot and dispatches the exact command through a distinct confirmed path once; cancel, back and dismiss dispatch nothing.
Tests prove no pre-confirm mutation, one post-confirm dispatch, cancel/back safety, and state restoration for a pending confirmation.
Non-destructive Execute behavior and existing navigation remain unchanged.
No Compose, data implementation, platform, schema or product-scope changes; specialist does not run Gradle or edit the ledger.
